text.en: This Order may be cited as the Protected Places (Consolidation) Order.

The places or premises specified in the first column of the Schedule which are more particularly described in the plans specified in the second column thereof deposited in the office of the Surveyor-General are hereby declared to be protected places for the purposes of the Act. Authority

The authorities specified in the third column of the Schedule are from whom permission to enter those respective places or premises is to be received.
